fiz: fazer — I did (preterite 1st sg., strong stem; qué vos fiz 'what did I do to you'; = hice)
sirviéndovos: servir + vos — serving you (gerund + enclitic vos; yo sirviéndovos sin art 'I serving you without guile'; = sirviéndoos)
conssejastes: consejar — you plotted, advised (preterite 2nd pl., -astes ending, ss spelling; vos conssejastes mi muort 'you plotted my death'; = aconsejasteis, here tramasteis)
muort: muerte — death (fem. noun, apocopated; Pidal's mu[o]rt, with the diphthong; mi muort 'my death'; = muerte)
aquim: aquí + me — here I (aquí + enclitic me, e dropped; aquim parto de vos 'here I part from you'; = aquí me)
traydores: traidor — traitor (masc. pl.; de malos e de traydores 'from wicked men and traitors'; = traidores)
grade: gradar + se — may he be glad, take pleasure (present subjunctive 3rd sg., optative, the se in que[s]; d' aqueste casamiento que[s] grade el Campeador 'may the Campeador be glad of this marriage'; as Grádanse v. 172; = se alegre)
quommo: commo — as, like (spelling variant with quo-, Pidal's qu[o]mmo; quommo de buen seso 'like one of good sense'; = como)
movieron: mover — they set out, moved off (preterite 3rd pl., strong; movieron del Anssarera 'they set out from the Anssarera'; = movieron)
acójense: acoger + se — they set about, betake themselves (present 3rd pl. + enclitic se; acójense a andar 'they set about travelling'; = se acogen)
ssiniestro: siniestro — left (hand, side), noun use (a ssiniestro 'on the left'; double s is a spelling; = izquierda)
passáronla: passar + la — they crossed it (preterite 3rd pl. + enclitic la; la sierra de Miedes passáronla 'the range of Miedes they crossed'; = la pasaron)
assiniestro: a + siniestro — on the left (a written together with siniestro; assiniestro dexan 'on the left they leave'; = a la izquierda)
griza: Griza — a place on the Infantes' left between the Montes Claros and San Esteban, said to have been settled by Álamos (a Griza que Álamos pobló); Pidal gives no note here; otherwise unidentified
álamos: Álamos — a man's name, the settler or founder of Griza (que Álamos pobló 'which Álamos founded'); otherwise unidentified here
pobló: poblar — he settled, founded (preterite 3rd sg.; Griza que Álamos pobló 'Griza, which Álamos settled'; = pobló)
caños: caño — conduit, cavern, perhaps 'caves, grottoes' (masc. pl.; allí son caños 'there are caverns'; sense inferred from context, uncertain)
elpha: Elpha — a woman's name (Elfa), the person shut away at Griza (do a Elpha ençerró 'where he shut up Elpha'; a = personal a; otherwise unidentified)
ençerró: encerrar — he shut in, confined (preterite 3rd sg.; do a Elpha ençerró 'where he shut Elpha up'; = encerró)
asant: a + Sant — San (a before a place-name object of dexan, as a Griza v. 2694, + apocopated Sant before Estevan; a diestro dexan aSant Estevan 'on the right they leave San Esteban'; = a San)
aluon: alueñe — far, at a distance (adverb, Pidal's alu[o]n; mas ca[d]e aluon 'but it lies far off'; = lejos)
robredo: robredo — oak wood, oak grove (masc.; el robredo de Corpes 'the oak wood of Corpes'; = robledo, robledal)
corpes: Corpes — the oak wood where the daughters are abandoned (robredo de Corpes); Pidal: it has disappeared today, and lay south-west of San Esteban de Gormaz
altos: alto — high, tall (masc. pl.; los montes son altos 'the woods are high'; = altos)
ramas: rama — branch (fem. pl.; las ramas pujan 'the branches climb'; = ramas)
pujan: pujar — they rise, climb (present 3rd pl.; las ramas pujan con las nuoves 'the branches climb up to the clouds'; = suben)
nuoves: nube — cloud (fem. pl., Pidal's nu[ov]es with the diphthong; = nubes)
aderredor: aderredor — around, round about (adverb, a- + derredor; que andan aderredor 'that range around'; = alrededor)
vergel: vergel — orchard, pleasant garden (masc.; un vergel con una linpia fuont 'a garden with a clear spring'; = vergel)
fuont: fuente — spring (fem., apocopated, Pidal's fu[o]nt with the diphthong; linpia fuont 'a clear spring'; = fuente)
mandan: mandar — they order (present 3rd pl.; mandan fincar la tienda 'they order the tent pitched'; = mandan)
demuéstranles: demostrar + les — they show them (present 3rd pl. + enclitic les; demuéstranles amor 'they show them love'; = les demuestran)
cunplieron: cumplir — they carried out, fulfilled (preterite 3rd pl.; mal gelo cunplieron 'ill they carried it out for them', apparently ironic; = cumplieron)
mandaron: mandar — they ordered (preterite 3rd pl.; assí lo mandaron 'so they ordered'; = mandaron)
albergaron: albergar — they lodged, took shelter (preterite 3rd pl.; do albergaron de noch 'where they lodged by night'; = albergaron)
criazón: criazón — household, those reared in a lord's house (fem. collective; los de criazón 'the household folk', Pidal 'sus familiares, las personas criadas en su casa'; = criados)
fincás: fincar — (that) he should remain (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg., -ás by apocope for fincasse; que non i fincás ninguno 'that none should stay there'; = quedase)
comidieron: comedir — they planned, intended (preterite 3rd pl.; tanto mal comidieron 'so much harm they plotted'; Pidal 'meditaron'; = meditaron, tramaron; modern comedirse means 'to be obliging')
escarnidas: escarnir — mocked, dishonored (past part. fem. pl., agreeing with the daughters; seredes escarnidas 'you will be shamed'; = escarnecidas)
fieros: fiero — wild, rugged, dread (masc. pl.; fieros montes 'wild woods'; = fieros)
daxadas: dexar — abandoned, left (past part. fem. pl., a-spelling for dexadas; daxadas seredes de nos 'you will be abandoned by us'; = dejadas)
vengaremos: vengar — we shall avenge (future 1st pl.; nos vengaremos aquesta por la del león 'we shall avenge this for the lion affair'; = vengaremos)
páranlas: parar + las — they leave them, set them (present 3rd pl. + enclitic las; páranlas en cuerpos 'they leave them in their shifts only'; = las dejan, las ponen)
camisas: camisa — shift, undergarment (fem. pl.; en camisas 'in their shifts'; = camisas)
espuelas: espuela — spur (fem. pl.; espuelas tienen calçadas 'they have spurs on'; = espuelas)
calçadas: calçar — put on, fitted (past part. fem. pl., agreeing with espuelas; espuelas tienen calçadas 'they have their spurs on'; = calzadas)
çinchas: çincha — girth, saddle strap (fem. pl.; spelling variant of cinchas; = cinchas)
duradores: durador — lasting, tough (adjective pl., one form for both genders, here with fem. çinchas; çinchas fuertes e duradores 'strong, tough girths'; = duraderas)
rogamos: rogar — we beg (present 1st pl.; por Dios vos rogamos 'we beg you for God's sake'; = rogamos)
tajadores: tajador — cutting, keen (adjective pl., one form for both genders, here with fem. espadas; espadas fuertes e tajadores 'strong, sharp swords'; = cortantes)
cortandos: cortar + nos — cut for us (imperative 2nd pl. cortad + enclitic nos with the d and n transposed; cortandos las cabeças 'cut off our heads'; as dándoslas v. 2081, indos v. 832; = cortadnos)
mártires: mártir — martyr (masc. pl.; mártires seremos 'we shall be martyrs'; = mártires)
departirán: departir — they will discuss, talk over (future 3rd pl.; departirán desta razón 'will talk about this matter'; = departirán, hablarán; modern departir 'to converse')
mereçemos: merecer — we deserve (present 1st pl.; por lo que nos mereçemos 'for what we deserve'; = merecemos)
prendemos: prender — we receive, get (present 1st pl.; no lo prendemos nos 'we do not receive it'; = recibimos; sense 'suffer' perhaps)
enssienplos: enssienplo — notable deed, act (Pidal 'hecho notable, acción'; masc. pl., Latin exemplum; atan malos enssienplos non fagades sobre nos 'do not do such wicked deeds upon us'; = ejemplos, here hechos)
fuéremos: seer — we may be, if we are (future subjunctive 1st pl.; si nos fuéremos majadas 'if we are beaten'; = fuéremos)
majadas: majar — beaten, battered (past part. fem. pl., agreeing with nos; fuéremos majadas 'we are beaten'; = majadas; modern majar 'to pound')
abiltaredes: abiltar — you will dishonor (future 2nd pl., -edes; abiltaredes a vos 'you will dishonor yourselves'; = envileceréis)
retraer: retraer — to reproach, cast up (infinitive; retraer vos lo an 'they will reproach you with it', split future with an 'they will'; = reprochar)
cortes: corte — court, royal assembly (fem. pl.; en vistas o en cortes 'at meetings or at courts'; = cortes)
ruegan: rogar — they beg (present 3rd pl., with the diphthong; lo que ruegan las dueñas 'what the ladies beg'; = ruegan)
corredizas: corredizo — running, slip (fem. pl.; çinchas corredizas 'running girths', perhaps loose-ended or slipping straps; = corredizas, modern 'sliding'; nuance uncertain)
májanlas: majar + las — they beat them (present 3rd pl. + enclitic las; májanlas tan sin sabor 'they beat them so without mercy'; = las majan)
agudas: agudo — sharp (fem. pl.; espuelas agudas 'sharp spurs'; = agudas)
ronpien: romper — they were tearing (imperfect 3rd pl., -ie ending; ronpien las camisas 'they were tearing the shifts'; = rompían)
carnes: carne — flesh (fem. pl.; las camisas e las carnes 'the shifts and the flesh'; = carnes)
sienten: sentir — they feel (present 3rd pl.; ya lo sienten 'now they feel it'; = sienten)
assomasse: assomar — (that) he might appear (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg.; que assomasse essora el Çid 'that the Cid might appear just then'; = asomase)
majaron: majar — they beat (preterite 3rd pl.; tanto las majaron 'so much they beat them'; = majaron)
cosimente: cosimente — (sin cosimente) probably 'without strength, exhausted' (Pidal: probablemente 'sin fuerzas, agotadas'; noun, rare; sin cosimente son 'they have no strength left'; no modern equivalent, closest sin fuerzas)
sangrientas: sangriento — bloody, blood-stained (fem. pl.; sangrientas en las camisas 'bloody on the shifts'; = sangrientas)
ciclatones: çiclatón — ciclatón, a rich silk cloth (masc. pl.; spelling variant with c-; = ciclatones)
canssados: cansar — tired, weary (past part. masc. pl., ss spelling; canssados son de ferir 'they are tired of striking'; = cansados)
ensayandos: ensayar + se — exerting themselves (Pidal 'esforzándose', as at v. 2388) (gerund + enclitic se, e dropped; ensayandos amos quál dará mejores colpes 'both vying as to who will give the better blows'; = ensayándose)
muertas: muerto — dead (past part. fem. pl.; por muertas las dexaron 'they left them for dead'; = muertas)
dexaron: dexar — they left (preterite 3rd pl.; por muertas las dexaron 'they left them for dead'; = dejaron)
leváronles: levar + les — they took from them (preterite 3rd pl. + enclitic les, dative of removal; leváronles los mantos 'they took their cloaks from them'; = les llevaron)
armiñas: armiño — of ermine (adjective, fem. pl.; pieles armiñas 'ermine furs'; = de armiño)
déxanlas: dexar + las — they leave them (present 3rd pl. + enclitic las; déxanlas marridas 'they leave them fainting'; = las dejan)
marridas: marrido — afflicted, grieved; here fainting, in a swoon (fem. pl.; Pidal: generalmente 'afligido, apenado'; aquí 'desmayado'; déxanlas marridas 'they leave them fainting'; = desmayadas)
briales: brial — tunic, a close-fitting robe of rich cloth (masc. pl.; Pidal: la camisa y el brial o ciclatón, note to v. 2721; en briales y en camisas 'in their tunics and shifts'; = briales)
bivas: bivo — alive (fem. pl.; non por bivas 'not as living'; = vivas)
assomas: assomar — (if) he might appear (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg., apocopated -ás for -asse, assomás; serie si assomas essora el Çid 'what fortune it would be if the Cid appeared then'; = asomase)
ívanse: ir + se — they went (on) (imperfect 3rd pl. + enclitic se, the se belonging to alabando: ívanse alabando 'they went boasting', = iban alabándose; = se iban)
alabando: alabar — praising, boasting (gerund; ellos ívanse alabando 'they went off boasting'; = alabándose)
vengados: vengar — avenged (past part. masc. pl.; somos vengados 'we are avenged'; = vengados)
deviemos: dever — we ought (imperfect 1st pl., old -iemos ending = -íamos; non las deviemos tomar 'we ought not to have taken them'; = debíamos)
varraganas: barragana — concubine, a woman kept without marriage (fem. pl.; tomar por varraganas 'to take as concubines'; = barraganas)
fossemos: seer — we were (imperfect subjunctive 1st pl., -ssemos, Pidal's f[o]ssemos; si non fossemos rogados 'unless we were asked'; = fuésemos)
rogados: rogar — asked, begged (past part. masc. pl.; si non fossemos rogados 'unless we were asked'; = rogados)
parejas: pareja — equal, peer, match (fem. pl.; nuestras parejas 'our equals', Pidal 'iguales nuestras', the noun later 'lawful wife'; = parejas, iguales)
desondra: desondra — dishonor, outrage (fem., des- + onra; la desondra del león 'the dishonor of the lion'; = deshonra)
assís: assí + se — thus (assí + reflexive/impersonal se; assís irá vengando 'so it will be avenged'; = así se)
vengando: vengar — avenging, being avenged (gerund; irá vengando 'it will go on being avenged'; ir + gerund; = vengando)

__broaden__.ques: que + se — who ... themselves (que, relative pronoun, + reflexive se; los ques pudieron escapar 'those who managed to escape'; = los que se pudieron escapar) · also ques — qué + se, 'what … to' (interrogative que + se; non sabent ques far 'they know not what to do', as qué se far at v. 1155; no note in Pidal; = qué hacer) · also fata ques torne 'until he returns' (conjunction fata que + reflexive se; = hasta que se vuelva) · also ques — que + se, conjunction 'that' + reflexive (que otro dia … ques tornasse cada uno 'that next day … each should return'; = que se) · also ques — que + se, optative 'may' (d' aqueste casamiento que[s] grade el Campeador 'may the Campeador be pleased with this marriage'; = que se)
__broaden__.torna: tornar — turn back, come back (imperative 2nd sg.; acá torna 'turn back here'; = vuelve) · also tornar — he gives back, returns (present 3rd sg.; nol torna recabdo 'gives her no heed, no answer'; = devuelve)
__broaden__.recabdo: recabdo — care, precaution, strict order (= recaudo) · also recabdo — business secured, a sure outcome (con todo buen recabdo 'with everything well in hand') · recabdo — account, reckoning (oro e plata que non saben recabdo 'gold and silver past all reckoning') · also con recabdo — within bounds, under control (non es con recabdo el dolor de Valençia 'the grief of Valencia is past all bounds') · also todo el recabdo está 'every precaution is taken' (Pidal: 'hay toda clase de precauciones'; en Medina todo el recabdo está) · also non avie recabdo — there was no counting or reckoning (de los colpes de las lanças non avie recabdo 'the lance blows could not be reckoned'; sense uncertain, from the 'account, reckoning' sense; Pidal gives no note here) · also recabdo — answer, reply, heed (el una al otra nol torna recabdo 'neither gives the other heed or answer'; sense taken from context, Pidal gives no note)
__broaden__.irá: ir — it will go (future 3rd sg.; irá a mal 'will go to ruin'; = irá) · also ir + gerund, 'will go on being' (assís irá vengando 'so it will go on being avenged'; = irá)
__broaden__.sabor: sabor — pleasure, wish; a so sabor 'at his (their) pleasure' · also por sabor de 'out of a wish to please, for the sake of' (por sabor de mio Çid 'to please the Cid') · also por sabor que — 'out of the desire (that)' (por sabor que avía de algún moro matare 'out of the longing I had to kill some Moor') · also aver sabor — to long for, to wish (lo que avía sabor 'what I longed for'; a qui yo ovier sabor 'to whomever I please', Pidal 'quisiere') · also mal sabor — pain, distress (don ellas an mal sabor 'from which they have pain'); sin sabor — 'without pleasure, without mercy' (májanlas tan sin sabor 'they beat them so without mercy'; sense perhaps)
__broaden__.por: por — through, along, by, for · purpose, 'in order to' (por el reyno quitar 'to quit the kingdom'); por + inf. 'yet to be done' (tres an por troçir 'three remain to pass'); 'for, on behalf of' (por mio Çid) · also por — 'out of, because of' (por miedo 'through fear'); 'for (that reason)' (por tal lo faze 'he does it for that reason'); 'by way of' (por Guadalfajara); por + noun 'for the sake of' ; por coraçón 'willingly' · also 'for (a price)' (por quanto serié conprada 'for how much it would be bought'); 'by means of' (por carta 'by writ'); 'through, thanks to' (por mí ganaredes 'through me you will gain') · also por — 'on, during (a time)' (por aquesta mañana 'this morning'); 'by way of, through' (por medio de la llaña 'through the middle of the plain') · also por — 'in' after fiar (yo fío por Dios 'I trust in God') · also por — 'to fetch, for' after enbiar/ir (enbiaré por ellas, irán por ellas 'I shall send for them', 'they will go for them'); por cuenta 'by count, in a count' · also por — as (por heredad 'as a possession') · also por — 'about, after' with preguntar (por el rey tómanse a preguntar 'they begin to ask after the king'); por + infinitive 'for … to' (por … vençer reyes, 'for … to defeat kings') · also por — 'in requital for, to avenge' (nos vengaremos aquesta por la del león 'we shall avenge this one for the lion affair'); por muertas 'for dead, as dead'; por lo que 'for what, on account of what'
__broaden__.sobre: sobre — upon, over; here 'on the security of' (sobre aquellas arcas) · sobre Navas de Palos 'above, hard by Navas de Palos' (position along the route) · also 'before, against (a town to be besieged)' (sobre Alcoçer iva posar 'went to camp before Alcocer') · also sobre — 'besides, in addition to' (Sobre aquesto todo 'on top of all this') · also sobre — around (Pidal 'alrededor de', comp. v. 1053; fincan sobre so señor 'they stand around their lord') · also sobre — 'upon, to' of the target of an act (atan malos enssienplos non fagades sobre nos 'do not set such evil examples upon us')
__broaden__.nos: nos — we (subject pronoun; = nosotros) · also nos — us, to us (object pronoun; atorgar nos hedes 'you will grant us') · also reflexive 'ourselves' (nos partimos 'we part'); dative (la missa nos dirá 'will say for us') · also nos' — non + se (aun nos' van del campo 'they are still not leaving the field'; the apostrophe marks the elision) · also nos — non + se, written without apostrophe (nin amigo a amigo nos pueden consolar 'nor can friend console friend'; mas le vienen … que nos le van 'more come to him than leave him', the no redundant after the comparison) · also nos — stressed 'us' after a preposition (daxadas seredes de nos 'you will be abandoned by us'; sobre nos 'upon us'); stressed repeated subject (mártires seremos nos 'we shall be martyrs')
__broaden__.vos: vos — you (object pronoun, polite/plural) · also subject 'you' (vos, que por mí dexades 'you who leave for my sake'); dative 'to you' (dar vos quiero vuestra part) · also reflexive/ethic 'you (yourselves)' (id vos en algara 'go off on a raid'); dative with an impersonal sense (si cueta vos fore 'if need befall you') · also vos — stressed 'you' after a preposition (parto de vos 'I part from you'; abiltaredes a vos 'you will dishonor yourselves')
__broaden__.cade: caer — falls (present 3rd sg., cade with its -d- kept; Pidal's restoration [cade]; cade en alcança 'falls in pursuit', i.e. gives chase, an idiom whose sense is taken from context; = cae) · also caer — falls down, stumbles (literal sense, present 3rd sg.; o comigo non cade 'or does not fall with me'; = cae) · also cade aluon — 'lies far off' (mas ca[d]e aluon 'but it lies far away', of a place's position; = queda lejos)
__broaden__.con: con — with · also con — 'with the help of' (con Dios 'with God's help'; verlo hemos con Dios 'we shall see it with God's help') · also con — 'up to, as high as' (las ramas pujan con las nuoves 'the branches climb up to the clouds', Pidal 'suben hasta las nubes')
__broaden__.dar: dar — to give (infinitive; split future dar gelos [hemos] = se los daremos) · also dar salto 'to make a dash, sally' (salto davan); dar çevada 'to give barley, feed the horses' · also dar — to give way, yield (oviéronse a dar 'they had to give way'; = ceder, rendirse) · also to strike, deal blows (les conpieçan a dar 'they begin to strike them')
__broaden__.montes: monte — mountain (masc. pl.; los Montes Claros; = montes) · also monte — wood, wooded upland (los montes son altos 'the woods are high'; en estos fieros montes 'in these wild woods')
__broaden__.monte: monte — mount, mountain (= monte) · also monte — wood, forest (las aves del monte 'the birds of the forest')
__broaden__.fieras: fiero — great, mighty, extraordinary (fem. pl.; fieras ganançias 'great gains'; modern fiero 'fierce', so a weaker sense here (uncertain nuance); = grandes) · also fiero — wild, savage (bestias fieras 'wild beasts'; = fieras)
__broaden__.bestias: bestia — beast, mount (fem. pl.; riding/pack animals; = bestias) · also bestia — wild beast (bestias fieras 'wild beasts', las bestias de la fiera guisa 'the savage beasts')
__broaden__.cuerpos: cuerpo — body · also en cuerpos — in only the clothing next the body (páranlas en cuerpos, Pidal 'las dejan a cuerpo')
__broaden__.nombre: nombre — name; por nombre 'by name, called' (= nombre) · also a nombre — perhaps 'in plenty, in great number' (averes [a nombre], both words Pidal's restoration; he gives no note; sense uncertain)
